column1: # [OLD / DEPRECATED] This deterministic hard-counter FAILED after decks were
# scaled to 21+ cards and action choice became stochastic (temp 2): it can no
# longer reliably assemble its combo each turn. Kept for reference only.
# Found by search. Close Quarters (Knife Lunge) can't be blocked by the target's
# already-resolved cards -- denying the fast deck its resolve-then-block-free
# tempo -- while a spread of real attacks + Shield Bash (super Mid) grind it down.
